newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovakia's 1997 GDP seen growing 5 pct - finmin.
newsitem.headline: Slovakia's 1997 GDP seen growing 5 pct - finmin.

text.p: Slovakia's 1997 gross domestic product (GDP) is forecast to grow by at least five percent, and the country's inflation rate should keep at or below six percent, the finance ministry said on Tuesday.

"In the macroeconomic sphere, the 1997 state budget should in principle reckon with a GDP growth of at least five percent, and with an inflation rate of no more than six percent," said a ministry document presented to a cabinet session.
The government statistical bureau had forecast 1996 real GDP to rise 7.1 percent. It grew 7.3 percent in the first quarter after 7.4-percent growth in 1995.
The bureau forecast inflation of 5.2 percent in 1996. In July, year-on-year inflation stood at 5.5 percent.
